name: io.github.fabio-rovai/open-ontologies
title: Open Ontologies
description: AI-native ontology engineering MCP server: validate, query, diff, lint, version, and govern RDF/OWL ontologies with 116 tools and 6 workflow prompts via an Oxigraph triple store. All 116 tools ship in a default build; 8 need an optional Cargo feature (embeddings, plugins, postgres or duckdb).
